name: Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited
summary: Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking products and services to individuals, corporates, small and medium-sized businesses, and financial institutions. The company operates through Retail, Commercial, and Others segments. The Retail segment offers a range of banking and related financial services, such as current and savings accounts, fixed deposits, bills of exchange, housing loans, credit cards, personal loans and sale finance loans, hire-purchase and leasing, wealth management, and bancassurance products.
